hero.eyebrow: Osmell Caicedo, based in Colombia, working remotely
hero.headline: Software and AI engineer, with Laravel at the core.
hero.lede: Shipping web products since 2014. Ten years rescuing and scaling Laravel systems, an agentic workflow that makes me faster, and products of my own.
hero.ctaPrimary: Email me to book a call

foundation.label: Foundation
foundation.headline: Ten years building Laravel systems that don't break.
foundation.lede: I take legacy apps where validation, presentation and business logic are tangled together, and move them to modern Laravel without breaking behavior. Livewire decomposition, Inertia and Vue migrations, Filament panels, serious API integrations, open-source packages.

craft.label: Craft
craft.headline: The pro version of things, down to the last millisecond.
craft.lede: AI-augmented since 2023. I measure work by return, not by hours. I squeeze performance, cut what doesn't pay off, and use AI agents to move faster, with architecture and judgment still in my hands.
craft.performance: Level60: heaviest SQL Server queries cut from 5 s to 900 ms with targeted queries, Redis and Octane. Malta Pharmacy: 800+ pages generated at build time, zero runtime database. laravel-missing-index: catches missing indexes before production does.
craft.agentic: Claude Code with custom agents for code review, security audits and testing. I design the system; agents execute and get reviewed.
craft.ai: Instructor Virtual grades SENA coursework against evaluation rubrics with AI, 1,200+ evidences analyzed so far. VoiceMyGoals generates voice audio. This site serves an llms.txt for AI assistants.
craft.proof: This page is the proof. {count} particles and custom GLSL shaders, running at {fps} fps. Turn on your camera and the sculpture rebuilds from your face. No frame ever leaves your browser.

building.label: Building
building.headline: And I build my own products.
building.lede: Products I design, ship and run myself, from multi-tenant SaaS to programmatic SEO. Some are live, some are on the workbench.
